passages.heading: Who is eligible for benefits
passages.passage_text: Full-time employees, those scheduled for 30 or more hours per week, are eligible for all benefits in this guide. Part-time employees are eligible for the retirement plan and the Employee Assistance Program only.

passages.heading: When coverage starts
passages.passage_text: Health, dental, and vision coverage starts on the first day of the month after you complete 30 days of employment. You must enroll within 30 days of your start date. If you do not enroll in time, you will have no coverage until the next open enrollment period.

passages.heading: Health insurance plans
passages.passage_text: Maple Ridge Services offers two medical plans: the Standard PPO plan and the High-Deductible plan with a Health Savings Account. The company pays 80% of the employee-only premium for the Standard PPO plan and 90% for the High-Deductible plan. You can add a spouse, partner, or children to either plan.

passages.heading: Dental and vision coverage
passages.passage_text: The dental plan covers two cleanings per year at no cost to you. The vision plan covers one eye exam every 12 months and provides a $150 allowance for glasses or contact lenses every 24 months.

passages.heading: Retirement plan
passages.passage_text: All employees can join the 401(k) retirement plan starting on their first day. The company matches 100% of the first 4% of pay you contribute. Company matching contributions become fully yours after two years of employment.

passages.heading: Life and disability insurance
passages.passage_text: Full-time employees receive basic life insurance equal to one year of base salary at no cost. Short-term disability insurance pays 60% of your base pay for up to 12 weeks if you cannot work because of an illness or injury.

passages.heading: Employee Assistance Program
passages.passage_text: The Employee Assistance Program offers free, confidential counseling for personal, family, and work concerns. You can receive up to six counseling sessions per issue each year. The program is available 24 hours a day by phone.

passages.heading: Changing your benefits
passages.passage_text: You can change your benefit choices during open enrollment each November. Outside open enrollment, you can make changes only within 30 days of a qualifying life event, such as marriage, the birth or adoption of a child, or the loss of other coverage. For questions, contact the HR Service Desk at extension 2200.
